name: Leon Grant
source:
[i]"You're more than an ally... You're a dear friend."[/i]

[i]Impatient Sage[/i]

The heroine's teammate. He's an honor student with a strong sense of justice, but he also suffers from a certain complex. The scenery featured in the photo left by his mother, a former Sylphid, has captured his heart.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=leon]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
